old: A 2001 1 rupee coin from India. The value side shows रुपया (rupee in Hindi), a big 1, the word RUPEE and the year 2001, flanked by grain stalks, with the small dot mint mark of the Noida mint. The obverse shows the Ashoka Lion Capital. Struck in stainless steel.

old: A 1964 20 centavos coin from Mexico. The reverse shows the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan, with the volcanoes Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl and a radiant Phrygian cap (cap of liberty), a large 20, the word CENTAVOS, the date and the Mo mint mark. The obverse shows the national arms. Struck in brass (95% copper, 5% zinc).
